title: Trapezoidal channel at a trial depth of 0.60 m (FHWA HDS-4 Example 4.2)

source.citation: FHWA, Introduction to Highway Hydraulics, HDS-4 (June 1997, metric), Example 4.2

verification: Re-derived by script (Python, outside the repository): A = (1.5 + 2 × 0.6) × 0.6 = 1.62 m²; P = 1.5 + 2 × 0.6 × √5 = 4.1833 m; R = 0.38726 m; V = R^(2/3) × 0.002^(1/2) / 0.013 = 1.8277 m/s; Q = 2.9609 m³/s. The book prints A 1.62, P 4.18, Q ≈ 2.96; tolerances are half a unit in the last printed digit. Not checked here: the book's V = 1.85 m/s, which it computes from the design discharge Q = 3 m³/s (V = 3/1.62), not from the trial depth.
